status: Development analysis; data already inspected. Not blind preregistration or independent validation.
data: 2026-10-21 RunPod frozen package; current repaired runtime has no timing labels
primary: mechanisms/geometry, prepared/merged, 20 warmups, 3 processes x 100 retained iterations
quality_rule: Exclude whole configuration from calibration if any process last20/first20 outside [0.9,1.1], process max/min >1.10, or algorithm differs. Retain all raw rows and sensitivity results.
target: median of three process medians in microseconds; iterations are not independent repeats
loss: Nonnegative least squares in microseconds; total candidate weight one per shape within an implementation model. Fixed 1e-6 ridge on training-RMS-scaled coefficients, including intercept. No search.
validation: Leave all candidates, stages and repetitions of one complete shape out. Score every primary configuration, flag unstable ones separately. Also show all-primary-label sensitivity without claiming stable labels.

new_policy_scenarios.status: Unidentified sensitivity scenarios; not confidence bounds or calibrated forecasts. Larger contention can erase the gain. Current readiness changes also require new measurements.
